content.short: Cubist builds CubeSigner, a hardware-backed key management platform for high-performance use cases.
content.description: Cubist provides hardware-backed key management through CubeSigner, offered in both self-custody and end-user custody configurations. Signing policies are written as code and applied universally, covering advanced transaction types and self-custody staking for validators. Its Bascule Drawbridge product enforces bridge security in real time, checking withdrawals against expected deposits. The stack is used for wallet-as-a-service and embedded wallets in consumer apps and games as well as cross-chain DeFi.
content.meta: Cubist builds CubeSigner, a hardware-backed key management and signing platform for demanding workloads.
